say:0:1210309001:0.source_cn: 别偷懒，我——嗝！我盯着你们呢！

say:1:1210309002:0.text: You're new, right? Come here and keep your voice down...
say:1:1210309002:0.source_cn: 嘿，嘿——你们几个是新来的？这边来，小点声！

say:3:1210311001:0.text: Hey, were you three caught in the water or on the beach?
say:3:1210311001:0.source_cn: 嘿！你们几个，在水里被逮住的，还是岸上？

say:5:1210311003:0.text: Yeah, that's right! Those posy parrots can't catch us in the water!
say:5:1210311003:0.source_cn: 哈、我就知道！那帮粉毛鹦鹉在水上抓不住咱们！

say:6:1210311004:0.text: You mean the Carmine Whispers, right?

say:7:1210311005:0.text: Of course! Those legless prawns locked us up and have been making us move boxes and dig rocks every day. I swear when I get out I'm gonna blow them up.
say:7:1210311005:0.source_cn: 当然！呸！把老子和兄弟们抓来关在这天天搬箱子挖石头，等...

say:8:1210311006:0.text: Just pretend to work. Our <style="highlight">boss</style>... she'll definitely come rescue us.
say:8:1210311006:0.source_cn: 你们装好样子，咬牙凑合干，<style=highlig...

say:0:1210312001:0.text: What is he talking about...? Is he a member of the Water Wights?
say:0:1210312001:0.source_cn: 他在说什么……难道他是真的水鬼帮？！

say:1:1210312002:0.text: *Hiccup*... Hey! Keeping working! I'm watching you. Move those boxes!
say:1:1210312002:0.source_cn: 别偷懒，我——嗝！我盯着你们呢！把旁边的箱子也搬了！

say:2:1210314001:0.text: Hey, new fish. Save your strength, otherwise you'll be too weak when we escape. No one's gonna help you.
say:2:1210314001:0.source_cn: 新来的，干活省省力，不然逃跑时腿软，没人管你的死活！
say:2:1210314001:0.male: Hey, new fish. Save your strength, otherwise you'll be too weak when we escape. No one's gonna help you.
say:2:1210314001:0.female: Hey, new fish. Save your strength, otherwise you'll be too weak when we escape. No one's gonna help you.

say:3:1210314002:0.text: What are you guys planning? What's our escape plan?
say:3:1210314002:0.source_cn: 你们打算——咳，我是说，我们有逃跑计划吗？

say:4:1210314003:0.text: Compared to us, these posy parrots are like landlubbers in the water.
say:4:1210314003:0.source_cn: 这帮粉毛鹦鹉到了水里，和我们一比就是旱鸭子。

say:6:1210314004:0.text: The <style="highlight">Dead Tide Fleet</style> will destroy the Carmine Whispers! As long as we can hold out until the next wave of attacks, we'll definitely find a chance to slip away.
say:6:1210314004:0.male: The <style="highlight">Dead Tide Fleet</style> will destroy the Carmine Whispers! As long as we can hold out until the next wave of attacks, we'll definitely find a chance to slip away.
say:6:1210314004:0.female: The <style="highlight">Dead Tide Fleet</style> will destroy the Carmine Whispers! As long as we can hold out until the next wave of attacks, we'll definitely find a chance to slip away.

choice_prompt:7:1210314004.text: The <style="highlight">Dead Tide Fleet</style> will destroy the Carmine Whispers! As long as we can hold out until the next wave of attacks, we'll definitely find a chance to slip away.
choice_prompt:7:1210314004.source_cn: <style=highlight>死潮舰队</style>会成为血薇帮的噩梦！只要撑到舰队下一波进攻，我们一定能找到机会溜走。

say:8:1210314005:0.text: You're definitely new, aren't ya? You haven't met our boss, right? She's from the Dead Tide Fleet. She's one of <style="highlight">Captain Hodgkin</style>'s most trusted lieutenants.
say:8:1210314005:0.source_cn: 你们……新入伙的吗？还没见过大姐头吧，咱们大姐头就是死...
say:8:1210314005:0.male: You're definitely new, aren't ya? You haven't met our boss, right? She's from the Dead Tide Fleet. She's one of <style="highlight">Captain Hodgkin</style>'s most trusted lieutenants.
say:8:1210314005:0.female: You're definitely new, aren't ya? You haven't met our boss, right? She's from the Dead Tide Fleet. She's one of <style="highlight">Captain Hodgkin</style>'s most trusted lieutenants.

say:9:1210314006:0.text: And, oh yes, they're Graveborns! But who cares? As long as they can take over Rustport and free us, that's all that matters.
say:9:1210314006:0.source_cn: 亡灵，没错！但要是能帮我们拿下锈锚港，开放海路，管它呢...
say:9:1210314006:0.male: And, oh yes, they're Graveborns! But who cares? As long as they can take over Rustport and free us, that's all that matters.
say:9:1210314006:0.female: And, oh yes, they're Graveborns! But who cares? As long as they can take over Rustport and free us, that's all that matters.

say:10:1210314007:0.text: Just wait for the blaring horn of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style>. All those who hear its call will be scared spitless and jump ship the moment it arrives!
say:10:1210314007:0.male: Just wait for the blaring horn of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style>. All those who hear its call will be scared spitless and jump ship the moment it arrives!
say:10:1210314007:0.female: Just wait for the blaring horn of <style="highlight">the Immortal</style>. All those who hear its call will be scared spitless and jump ship the moment it arrives!

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你是说，传说中的亡灵海盗？

say:0:1210315001:0.text: *Hiccup*... Another one? Head over to that side!

say:1:1210315002:0.text: Alright, boss man! You can count on me!
say:1:1210315002:0.source_cn: 好嘞！我洗心革面，一定好好干！

say:3:1210316001:0.text: Hey, it's you again! You all don't look too bad.
say:3:1210316001:0.source_cn: 嘿，又见面了！看你们的样子，还不算太糟嘛？

say:4:1210316002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你怎么也被抓进来了？！

say:5:1210316003:0.text: Did you know that the innkeeper betrayed us?
say:5:1210316003:0.source_cn: 你介绍的那个旅店老板，把我们出卖了！

say:6:1210316004:0.text: We caught the damedangler and went back to the inn to report to Bols, but the Whispers were waiting for us. They accused us of being Water Wights and threw us in here.
say:6:1210316004:0.source_cn: 我们刚钓完冥湾美人，就有血薇帮的人在旅店埋伏，把我们当...

say:7:1210316005:0.text: Don't worry, my friends. The moment I heard what happened, I came here to help.
say:7:1210316005:0.source_cn: 朋友们，别急，知道你们有难，我这不就来帮你们了吗？

say:8:1210316006:0.text: Really? Weren't you also captured by the Whispers?
say:8:1210316006:0.source_cn: 帮我们？你不是被血薇帮抓进来的吗？

say:9:1210316007:0.text: Yes, I was captured, but it was on purpose. It's all part of my plan.
say:9:1210316007:0.source_cn: 没错啊，是被抓进来的。故意被他们抓住，是计划里的一环。

choice_prompt:10:1210316007.text: Yes, I was captured, but it was on purpose. It's all part of my plan.
choice_prompt:10:1210316007.source_cn: 没错啊，是被抓进来的。故意被他们抓住，是计划里的一环。

say:11:1210316012:0.text: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.
say:11:1210316012:0.source_cn: 至于计划嘛……这种时候，一般来说，“那个”最好用。但不...
say:11:1210316012:0.male: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.
say:11:1210316012:0.female: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.

choice_prompt:14:1210316012.text: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.
choice_prompt:14:1210316012.source_cn: 至于计划嘛……这种时候，一般来说，“那个”最好用。但不知道你们有没有。
choice_prompt:14:1210316012.male: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.
choice_prompt:14:1210316012.female: As for my plan, in these kinds of situations... if I had some "you know", things would go more smoothly.

say:15:1210316013:0.text: Money! Gold! Coin! Do I really have to spell it out for you?
say:15:1210316013:0.male: Money! Gold! Coin! Do I really have to spell it out for you?
say:15:1210316013:0.female: Money! Gold! Coin! Do I really have to spell it out for you?

say:16:1210316014:0.text: Bribes cost money. How am I supposed to convince the foreman to turn a blind eye without any coin? Plus, I deserve a little something too.
say:16:1210316014:0.source_cn: 贿赂贿赂，给点好处，让工头睁一只眼闭一只眼，有助于咱们...
say:16:1210316014:0.male: Bribes cost money. How am I supposed to convince the foreman to turn a blind eye without any coin? Plus, I deserve a little something too.
say:16:1210316014:0.female: Bribes cost money. How am I supposed to convince the foreman to turn a blind eye without any coin? Plus, I deserve a little something too.

say:17:1210316015:0.text: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...
say:17:1210316015:0.source_cn: 毕竟我冒了这么大风险，千里迢迢地赶来救你们几个啊——
say:17:1210316015:0.male: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...
say:17:1210316015:0.female: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...

choice_prompt:18:1210316015.text: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...
choice_prompt:18:1210316015.source_cn: 毕竟我冒了这么大风险，千里迢迢地赶来救你们几个啊——
choice_prompt:18:1210316015.male: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...
choice_prompt:18:1210316015.female: After all, I took a big risk coming here to save you...

say:19:1210316016:0.text: Really? Nothing? Not even a few coppers?
say:19:1210316016:0.source_cn: ……一点都没有？几个铜币也行啊。
say:19:1210316016:0.male: Really? Nothing? Not even a few coppers?
say:19:1210316016:0.female: Really? Nothing? Not even a few coppers?

say:21:1210316017:0.text: I do still have a few coppers left... Will it be enough?
say:21:1210316017:0.source_cn: 铜币倒是还剩几个……这样就可以？

say:24:1210316020:0.text: Listen, it's not hard to leave this cave. The foreman, Mork, is an old drunk. He stole some wine last night. If I can add something to his wine, he'll be passed out in no time.
say:24:1210316020:0.source_cn: 听我说，离开黑石洞不难。工头默克是个老酒鬼，昨晚又偷了...

say:25:1210316021:0.text: The tough part is the guards outside, but like I said, I have a plan.
say:25:1210316021:0.source_cn: 难的是怎么绕开洞外的守卫。不过这点也不是问题。

say:26:1210316022:0.text: I already know the terrain and the patrol schedule. You just need to stick close to me. Once we're out of the cave, just follow my instructions. Got it?
say:26:1210316022:0.source_cn: 这里的地形和巡逻规律我已经摸清了。你们悄悄地跟紧我，等...

say:30:1210316024:0.text: I guess there's no other way. We can't let <style="stress"><player_name></style> stay here any longer. If we rush out, that will just set off the alarms. This is a better plan.
say:30:1210316024:0.male: I guess there's no other way. We can't let <style="stress"><player_name></style> stay here any longer. If we rush out, that will just set off the alarms. This is a better plan.
say:30:1210316024:0.female: I guess there's no other way. We can't let <style="stress"><player_name></style> stay here any longer. If we rush out, that will just set off the alarms. This is a better plan.

say:31:1210316025:0.text: So, we're all in agreement, right?

say:32:1210316026:0.text: Alright, I'll give you a signal when I put our foreman friend to sleep.
say:32:1210316026:0.source_cn: 等着。等事情成了，我给你们信号。

narration:33:1210316027:0.text: After some time, Mork starts snoring loudly in the cave...
narration:33:1210316027:0.source_cn: 一段时间后……工头默克打起了鼾。

choice:18:0:1.text: Thanks, but I don't have any money.
choice:18:0:1.male: Thanks, but I don't have any money.
choice:18:0:1.female: Thanks, but I don't have any money.

say:35:1210316019:0.text: Nice, that's what I like to hear.

choice:18:1:2.text: Alright, I'll get you some coin.
choice:18:1:2.male: Alright, I'll get you some coin.
choice:18:1:2.female: Alright, I'll get you some coin.

choice:14:2:3.text: Just tell me what you need.
choice:14:2:3.male: Just tell me what you need.
choice:14:2:3.female: Just tell me what you need.

say:36:1210316008:0.text: ... Sinbad saved Chippy. Chippy will give him the benefit of the doubt. A knight needs to believe in the good of people.
say:36:1210316008:0.source_cn: ……辛巴达救了满满，满满愿意相信他！知恩图报也是骑士的美德！

say:37:1210316009:0.text: It doesn't matter if you believe me or not. Escaping this place is what matters, or do you want to spend the rest of your lives moving boxes for the Whispers?
say:37:1210316009:0.source_cn: 拜托，比起相不相信我，先从这里逃出去更重要吧。还是你们...

say:38:1210316010:0.text: ... Sinbad saved Chippy. Chippy will give him the benefit of the doubt. A knight needs to believe in the good of people.
say:38:1210316010:0.source_cn: ……辛巴达救了满满，满满愿意相信他！知恩图报也是骑士的美德！

say:39:1210316011:0.source_cn: 拜托，比起相不相信我，先从这里逃出去更重要吧。还是你们...

say:0:1210318001:0.text: Finally, fresh air! Chippy's never felt so good!
say:0:1210318001:0.source_cn: 终于出来了，满满从没觉得外面的空气这么清新。

say:1:1210318002:0.text: Keep your voice down! There are still guards ahead!
say:1:1210318002:0.source_cn: 小声点，前面有血薇帮的人！

say:0:1210319001:0.text: Go around the hill, climb down the net, and go out the gate.
say:0:1210319001:0.source_cn: 绕到山坡上，爬下布网，从大门口绕出去。

say:1:1210319002:0.source_cn: 准备好了吗？冒险开始了！

say:5:1210302001:0.text: Bols, what's going on?! Why do the Carmine Whispers have Chippy?
say:5:1210302001:0.source_cn: 老板，这是怎么回事？！为什么血薇帮的人会把满满抓起来！

say:6:1210302002:0.text: We've brought back the damedangler. Let Chippy go!
say:6:1210302002:0.source_cn: 你要的冥湾美人，我们已经带回来了，快放开满满！

say:7:1210302003:0.text: I don't care about the blasted fish. I can't believe you didn't get caught at the lumberyard.
say:7:1210302003:0.source_cn: 老子根本不在意那一两条鱼。你们竟然没被伐木场的人抓起来。

choice_prompt:9:1210302004.source_cn: <style=highlight>卢卡</style>二当家，这些水鬼是你的了。

choice:9:2:3.text: You need to get your eyes checked.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你们的视力着实不太好
choice:9:2:3.male: You need to get your eyes checked.
choice:9:2:3.female: You need to get your eyes checked.

narration:17:12010311:0.text: You and Hammie return to the inn with the damedangler and walk right into the trap set by the Carmine Whispers, who have captured Chippy.
narration:17:12010311:0.source_cn: 你和漫漫带着冥湾美人回到旅店，却发现血薇帮已经抓住了满...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1210304004:.text: Tie them up and take them away

say:7:1210306001:0.text: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.
say:7:1210306001:0.male: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.
say:7:1210306001:0.female: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.

choice_prompt:8:1210306001.text: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:8:1210306001.male: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.
choice_prompt:8:1210306001.female: So, Water Wight, tell me your name.

picture:13::0.text: A tattered banner featuring bones and sharp claws.
picture:13::0.source_cn: 画着骨头和利爪的破旧旗帜

say:15:1210306004:0.text: This is the sail from the boat we were using.
say:15:1210306004:0.source_cn: ——那是我们找到的船上的旗子！

say:17:1210306005:0.text: It's the<style="highlight"> flag of the Water Wights</style>.

say:18:1210306006:1.text: You came to Rustport on a Water Wight boat and injured our patrol team at the lumberyard. Do you have anything else to say?
say:18:1210306006:1.source_cn: 你们乘着水鬼帮的船来到锈锚港，又在伐木场打伤了我们的巡...

choice_prompt:19:1210306006.text: You came to Rustport on a Water Wight boat and injured our patrol team at the lumberyard. Do you have anything else to say?
choice_prompt:19:1210306006.source_cn: 你们乘着水鬼帮的船来到锈锚港，又在伐木场打伤了我们的巡查队。还有什么想说的？

say:20:1210306007:1.text: Every Wight we catch always says the same thing. You're smart enough to know that begging for mercy is useless at this point.
say:20:1210306007:1.source_cn: 每一个被抓住的水鬼都这么说。但聪明的人应该知道，这时候...

say:21:1210306008:1.text: Give up your accomplices and tell us why you're in Rustport, and we'll take it easy on you.
say:21:1210306008:1.source_cn: 供出你的同伙，说出你们潜入锈锚港的目的，或许你能少受点罪。

say:22:1210306009:1.text: Don't want to tell me? Most Water Wights aren't as stubborn as you.
say:22:1210306009:1.source_cn: ……不说吗？水鬼帮倒是少见你这样的倔骨头。

say:23:1210306010:1.text: Lucca, rip the tongues off those rodents.
say:23:1210306010:1.source_cn: 卢卡，撬开那两只小老鼠的嘴。

choice_prompt:24:1210306010.text: Lucca, rip the tongues off those rodents.
choice_prompt:24:1210306010.source_cn: 卢卡，撬开那两只小老鼠的嘴。

say:30:1210306013:0.text: Lucca, remove the cloth from their mouths.
say:30:1210306013:0.source_cn: 卢卡，把他们嘴里的布拿开。

say:32:1210306014:0.text: We're not Water Wights! Sinbad can attest to that!
say:32:1210306014:0.source_cn: 我们真的不是水鬼，辛巴达——辛巴达能证明！

say:33:1210306015:0.text: He saved us at the beach, took us to Bols' inn, and told us where to go fishing. He knows everything we did the last few days.
say:33:1210306015:0.source_cn: 他在海岸边救了我们，给我们介绍了旅店，又指了钓鱼的方向...

say:36:1210306017:1.text: It's that fish-brained urchin with the scar on his face. He's the one who recommended <style="highlight">Hugin</style>.
say:36:1210306017:1.source_cn: 那个脸上有疤的轻浮小子，<style=highligh...

say:37:1210306018:0.text: You can't trust anyone in Rustport, especially him.
say:37:1210306018:0.source_cn: 哼，锈锚港谁的话都不能信，尤其是他。

say:39:1210306019:1.text: Alright, keep talking. The information you provide will decide your fate.
say:39:1210306019:1.source_cn: 好了，继续交代。根据供出的情报，我会决定你的下场。

choice_prompt:40:1210306019.text: Alright, keep talking. The information you provide will decide your fate.
choice_prompt:40:1210306019.source_cn: 好了，继续交代。根据供出的情报，我会决定你的下场。

say:42:1210306021:0.text: Haven't you ever heard of Merlin? He's the greatest mage alive. Also, show some respect and address him as Magister Merlin.
say:42:1210306021:0.source_cn: 你们、你们完全没听说过吗？梅林是最伟大的魔法师！你们应...
say:42:1210306021:0.male: Haven't you ever heard of Merlin? He's the greatest mage alive. Also, show some respect and address him as Magister Merlin.
say:42:1210306021:0.female: Haven't you ever heard of Merlin? She's the greatest mage alive. Also, show some respect and address her as Magister Merlin.

say:44:1210306023:1.text: Isn't Rustport still a part of the Lightbearer Empire? How have you never heard of Magister Merlin?! I'm sorry to say this, but you are truly ill-informed.
say:44:1210306023:1.source_cn: 这里明明是耀光帝国的管辖地，你们竟然没听过梅林的名字？...
say:44:1210306023:1.male: Isn't Rustport still a part of the Lightbearer Empire? How have you never heard of Magister Merlin?! I'm sorry to say this, but you are truly ill-informed.
say:44:1210306023:1.female: Isn't Rustport still a part of the Lightbearer Empire? How have you never heard of Magister Merlin?! I'm sorry to say this, but you are truly ill-informed.

say:46:1210306025:1.text: Since you're unwilling to tell the truth, I'll have Lucca deal with you.
say:46:1210306025:1.source_cn: 既然不愿意说实话，卢卡，把他们处理了。

say:54:1210306029:1.text: Sonja, these people might be useful. We should not waste resources at a time like this.
say:54:1210306029:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，现在我们正是要用人的时候。别浪费资源。
